name: Maison: Clock & Photo Widgets
tagline: Elegant clock, photo, countdown and weather widgets, with wallpapers to match — designed on your iPhone.
storage_summary: Your widget designs, the photos you add to widgets, your saved wallpapers and your color themes are stored only on your iPhone, in storage shared between Maison and its widgets. Nothing you design is uploaded.

google_analytics.name: Google Analytics for Firebase
google_analytics.purpose: Measures how the app is used (for example whether a widget was saved or placed on the Home Screen, whether a set was applied, whether the Pro screen was opened and a purchase completed, and which errors people run into) so we can fix problems and improve Maison. Not used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
google_analytics.data: a small set of usage events and their settings (never your photos, your text, your calendar or anything you design), an app-instance identifier, app version, device model, OS version, locale, approximate region derived from your IP address, and purchase events (product and result)

apple_weatherkit.name: Apple Weather (WeatherKit)
apple_weatherkit.purpose: Provides the forecast shown on your Weather, Day Board and Greetings widgets.
apple_weatherkit.data: the location you choose for weather — your approximate current location if you allow it, or the city you add. It is sent to Apple to fetch the forecast and is not linked to you.

apple_storekit.name: Apple (App Store purchases)
apple_storekit.purpose: Processes your purchase or subscription payment and verifies that you own Maison Pro.
apple_storekit.data: your purchase receipt, handled by Apple. We never see your payment details, Apple Account or name.

data_sent.what: Usage events (no photos, no text you type, no calendar events, nothing you design), app-instance identifier, app and device info, approximate region, purchase events
data_sent.why: Understand how the app is used and improve it

data_sent.what: The location you choose for weather (current location or a city you add)
data_sent.why: Show the forecast on your widgets
Confirm that you own Maison Pro

stored_on_device: Your widget designs — styles, fonts, finishes, countdown dates and the text you write.
Photos you add to widgets. Photos you pick with Apple's photo picker are copied into Maison's storage on your iPhone, resized to at most 1000 pixels.
Wallpapers you save to the Library, and the color themes taken from them.
The screenshots you choose for the **Clear** finish. Maison cuts out only the area behind each widget and keeps that on your iPhone.
Your settings — onboarding progress, tips you have seen and your weather city.
Delete a design in **Library** (touch and hold it → Delete), or delete the app to remove everything.
not_collected: Your name, email address or any account — the app has no sign-in.
Your photos, the text you add or anything you design.
Your calendar events and the song playing in Apple Music. Maison reads them on your iPhone only to draw your widgets; they are not part of the usage events above.
Your photo library — Maison never browses it. You choose photos with Apple's photo picker, and the app only asks to **add** wallpapers to your library.
Your advertising identifier (IDFA), contacts or browsing history. Maison shows no ads, does not track you across apps and never shows the App Tracking Transparency prompt.

permissions.name: Photos (add only)
permissions.why: to save the wallpapers and Live Photos you choose to your photo library so you can set them as your background. Maison cannot read your library with this permission.

permissions.name: Location (while using the app)
permissions.why: to show local weather on your widgets. You can add a city by name instead.

permissions.name: Calendars
permissions.why: to show today's events on your Day Board widget. Events stay on your iPhone.

permissions.name: Apple Music
permissions.why: to show the song playing in Apple Music on your Music widget.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: only if you add the Daily Greeting control, to send your greeting at the time you pick.

your_controls: **Revoke any permission** in *iOS Settings → Maison*. Widgets that need it show a short note instead.
**Delete your data** by deleting designs in Library, or by deleting the app — everything Maison stored is on your iPhone.
**Cancel a subscription** in *iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions*, or from **Manage subscription** in Maison Settings.

subscription.restore_location: in Settings → Restore purchases, and at the bottom of the Maison Pro screen

support_faq.q: How do I add a widget to my Home Screen?
support_faq.a: Save a design in Maison, then touch and hold an empty spot on your Home Screen, tap **Edit → Add Widget**, search for Maison, pick a size and tap **Add Widget**. Maison shows these steps with an animation under **Settings → How to add widgets**.

support_faq.q: My widget shows a different design. How do I change it?
support_faq.a: Touch and hold the widget, tap **Edit Widget** and choose the design you want.

support_faq.q: Why is there no second hand on the clock?
support_faq.a: iOS updates widgets about once a minute, so no widget app can show a moving second hand. Maison's clocks show hours and minutes.

support_faq.q: Which music apps work with the Music widget?
support_faq.a: Apple Music only. iOS does not let widgets read what other music apps are playing.

support_faq.q: How does the Clear finish work?
support_faq.a: Clear places a cut-out of your wallpaper behind the widget so it blends in. Calibrate once in Light mode and once in Dark mode from **Settings → Calibrate Clear**. iOS still draws a thin glass edge around every widget, so the widget is very close to invisible but not fully.

support_faq.q: Why can't Maison set my wallpaper for me?
support_faq.a: iOS doesn't let apps change your wallpaper. Maison saves it to Photos for you; then open it in Photos, tap **Share → Use as Wallpaper**.

Yes. Clock, photo, countdown and text widgets, wallpapers and sets are free, with no ads. Maison Pro adds more finishes, typefaces, wallpapers and sets. Choose monthly, yearly (with a 7-day free trial) or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Anything free today stays free.

support_faq.q: How do I restore my purchase on a new device?
support_faq.a: Open *Settings → Restore purchases*, signed in with the same Apple ID you bought with.

support_faq.q: How do I delete my data?
support_faq.a: Delete designs in Library, or delete the app. Everything lives only on your iPhone, so this removes it completely.
